stories.hook: ¿Por qué el cortisol se eleva en la depresión aguda?
stories.headline: Cortisol sérico elevado y correlacionado con ansiedad en depresión de primer episodio
stories.finding: Los pacientes con depresión mayor de primer episodio y sin medicación presentaron niveles séricos de cortisol significativamente mayores (307,03 ± 77,80 nmol/L) que los controles sanos (261,13 ± 58,15 nmol/L). Además, el cortisol mostró una tendencia de correlación positiva con los factores de ansiedad, deterioro cognitivo, retardación y desesperanza evaluados por la HAMD‑24 y la SDS.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo refuerza la implicación del eje HPA en la fisiopatología de la depresión aguda y sugiere que la medición del cortisol podría servir como marcador biológico para identificar pacientes con mayor carga ansiosa y cognitiva, orientando intervenciones tempranas.
stories.paperTitle: Correlation between hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal function and clinical characteristics in the acute phase of first-episode drug-naive major depressive disorder
stories.originalAbstract: Background: First-episode drug-naïve depressive disorders have high heterogeneity in clinical features, and there is still room for in-depth exploration of the correlation with serum cortisol levels. This study aimed to explore the correlation between hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal (HPA) function in the acute phase of first-episode drug-naïve major depressive disorder (MDD) and clinical features evaluated by the Hamilton Depression Rating Scale (HAMD-24) and the Zung Self-Rating Depression Scale (SDS). Methods: Patients with first-episode drug-naïve MDD in the acute phase meeting the DSM-V diagnostic criteria were selected as the study group, and healthy individuals matched for gender and age were recruited as the control group. Serum cortisol levels were measured in both groups, and patients in the MDD group were evaluated using HAMD-24 and SDS. Results: The serum cortisol level in the MDD group(307.03 ± 77.80 nmol/L) was significantly higher than that in the healthy control group(261.13 ± 58.15 nmol/L) (Z-Value = -3.539, P < 0.05). The serum cortisol level showed a positive correlation trend (ρ > 0) with the anxiety factor, cognitive impairment factor, retardation factor, despair factor, total HAMD score, and SDS score, with statistical significance (p < 0.05). It showed a negative correlation trend (ρ < 0) with the sleep factor, without statistical significance (p > 0.05). It also showed a positive correlation trend (ρ > 0) with the weight factor and diurnal variation factor, without statistical significance (p > 0.05). Conclusion: A significant increase in serum cortisol level can serve as one of the biological indicators for predicting the core symptom clusters and disease severity of MDD. Regulation of The HPA axis cortisol pathway may have potential value in alleviating MDD symptoms.

stories.hook: ¿Puede entrenar la atención para frenar la rumiación?
stories.headline: La Técnica de Entrenamiento Atencional muestra eficacia general contra la rumiación
stories.finding: Una revisión sistemática incluyó 33 estudios que evaluaron la Attention Training Technique (ATT) como estrategia terapéutica meta‑cognitiva. Los resultados indican que ATT es generalmente eficaz para reducir patrones de pensamiento repetitivo, aunque su ventaja frente a controles activos varía según el estudio.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo respalda la incorporación de ATT en intervenciones clínicas para la rumiación, ofreciendo una herramienta basada en evidencia que mejora la flexibilidad cognitiva y disminuye el sobrepensar.
stories.paperTitle: Üstbilişsel Terapi Stratejisi Olarak Dikkat Eğitimi Tekniğinin Etkililiği: Sistematik Bir Gözden Geçirme
stories.originalAbstract: Dikkat Eğitimi Tekniği (Attention Training Technique – ATT), düşüncelere mesafeli farkındalığı artırmayı, tekrarlayıcı düşünme kalıplarını bozmayı ve yürütücü işlevlerde esnekliği artırmayı amaçlayan kısa süreli bir üstbilişsel terapi stratejisidir. Bu çalışma, söz konusu tekniğin farklı örneklemler üzerindeki etkililiğini değerlendiren araştırmaları sistematik olarak gözden geçirmeyi amaçlamaktadır. Bu kapsamda, “Attention training technique” anahtar kelimesi kullanılarak PsycINFO, Scopus, Web of Science ve PubMED veri tabanlarında yayımlanmış çalışmalar taranmıştır. Bu gözden geçirme çalışmasına belirli dahil etme kriterlerine dayanarak, toplam 33 etkililik çalışması (söz konusu veri tabanlarından elde edilen 30 ve diğer kaynaklardan 3 çalışma) dâhil edilmiştir. Bulgular; örneklem özellikleri, kontrol ve karşılaştırma koşulları, gruplara atama yöntemleri, ölçüm araçları, ölçüm sıklığı, seans özellikleri, çalışma sonuçları ve yanlılık riskinin değerlendirilmesi temelinde özetlenmiştir. Farklı örneklemler ve bağlamlarda elde edilen sonuçlar, ATT’nin genel olarak etkili olduğunu göstermektedir; ancak bu etkililik, aktif müdahale içeren kontrol gruplarıyla karşılaştırıldığında bazı ölçümlerle sınırlı kalmaktadır. Buna karşın, bekleme listesi veya bir müdahale uygulanmayan kontrol gruplarıyla yapılan karşılaştırmalarda daha belirgin ve anlamlı farklılıklar ortaya çıkmıştır. ATT, temelde üstbilişsel terapinin bir bileşeni olarak değerlendirilse de mevcut kanıtlar bu tekniğin tek başına uygulandığında da etkili olduğunu göstermektedir. Ayrıca, incelenen çalışmalar ATT’nin farklı terapi yaklaşımlarına entegre edilmesiyle de etkili sonuçlar verdiğini ortaya koymaktadır. Bağımsız değerlendiricilerin kullanıldığı, farklı örneklem gruplarının dâhil edildiği, farklı seans sayıları ve değişkenlerin test edildiği, ayrıca daha uzun izlem sürelerinin uygulandığı gelecek araştırmaların, ATT’nin etkililiğine katkı sunacağı düşünülmektedir.

stories.hook: ¿Puede la depresión perinatal predecir enfermedades cardíacas?
stories.headline: Depresión perinatal vinculada a diagnóstico cardiovascular en los primeros 24 meses
stories.finding: Una revisión narrativa destaca que la evidencia directa más robusta relaciona la depresión perinatal con diagnósticos cardiovasculares dentro de los 24 meses posteriores al parto. Para la ansiedad y otros trastornos, la evidencia sigue siendo indirecta y no concluyente.
stories.takeaway: Este vínculo sugiere que la detección y el tratamiento temprano de la depresión perinatal podrían ser una estrategia preventiva para reducir el riesgo cardiovascular materno, ampliando la atención clínica más allá del periodo postparto inmediato.
stories.paperTitle: Peripartum mental health and long-term cardiovascular risk: A neglected window for prevention in women
stories.originalAbstract: The peripartum period represents a critical window in women's health during which psychiatric, obstetric, metabolic and cardiovascular vulnerabilities may converge.Depression, anxiety, traumatic stress and sleep disturbance frequently coexist with adverse pregnancy outcomes and social disadvantage, yet their relevance for long-term maternal cardiovascular health remains incompletely understood.This narrative minireview examines epidemiological, biological, behavioral and clinical relationships between peripartum mental health and subsequent cardiovascular outcomes.The thematic literature search was selective rather than systematic.The strongest direct longterm evidence concerns perinatal depression; cardiovascular diagnoses within 24 months postpartum are distinguished from outcomes over longer follow-up.For anxiety, childbirth-related trauma, sleep disturbance and severe mental illness, much of the evidence remains indirect.Shared mechanisms and bidirectional relationships with obstetric complications support biological plausibility but do not establish causation.We propose a peripartum cardio-psychiatric phenotype integrating psychiatric, reproductive, cardiometabolic and social information.This framework and its descriptive patterns are hypothesis-generating, not validated risk categories.Guideline-supported mental health assessment and risk-based cardiovascular follow-up can support coordinated care, while the incremental predictive value and long-term cardiovascular benefit of the proposed integrated approach require prospective evaluation.

stories.hook: ¿Por qué la exposición funciona mejor en algunos trastornos de ansiedad?
stories.headline: La exposición CBT es clave en trastornos de ansiedad dominados por miedo
stories.finding: Los autores clasifican los cinco trastornos de ansiedad en tres grupos según la intensidad de miedo y ansiedad, relacionando la evitación con la edad de inicio. En los trastornos dominados por miedo (fobia específica y agorafobia), la terapia cognitivo-conductual basada en exposición reduce significativamente la evitación y la respuesta de miedo.
stories.takeaway: Este esquema guía a los clínicos a priorizar la exposición dentro de la TCC para fobias y agorafobia, optimizando resultados y personalizando el tratamiento según el perfil de miedo‑ansiedad del paciente.
stories.paperTitle: Clinical features and genetic mechanisms of anxiety, fear, and avoidance: A comprehensive review of five anxiety disorders
stories.originalAbstract: Anxiety disorders, including social anxiety disorder (SAD), generalized anxiety disorder (GAD), panic disorder (PD), agoraphobia (AG), and specific phobia (SP), are characterized by core features of excessive anxiety and fear. Furthermore, these disorders are often accompanied by avoidance behaviors. While avoidance is a common behavioral response, it may be a consequence of or a cocontributor to the anxiety and fear driving these disorders. This narrative review integrates the interactions among anxiety, fear, and avoidance behaviors across these five disorders and synthesizes findings from clinical, neuropsychological, brain function, treatment, genetic, and epigenetic studies. Based on the intensity of anxiety and fear, these anxiety five disorders can be categorized into three groups: fear-dominant (SP, AG), mixed (PD, SAD), and anxiety-dominant (GAD). The intensity of avoidance behaviors is related to the age of onset. Each group responds to different treatment approaches. In fear-dominant disorders, exposure therapy is highly effective in reducing avoidance behaviors and fear responses. Cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) with an emphasis on exposure is useful. In the mixed group, CBT is the preferred treatment, with a focus on both exposure therapy and cognitive restructuring. In addition to CBT, selective serotonin and serotonin-norepinephrine reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs/SNRIs) are commonly used to reduce anticipatory anxiety and fear symptoms. In anxiety-dominant disorders, both SSRIs/SNRIs and CBT with an emphasis on cognitive restructuring are effective for managing chronic worry. Anxiety and fear are regulated by distinct but interacting neurobiological mechanisms, with the amygdala central to fear processing and the hypothalamic‒pituitary‒adrenal axis involved in chronic anxiety regulation. Genetic and epigenetic studies demonstrate substantial heritability across anxiety disorders, with varying degrees of genetic influence on anxiety, fear, and avoidance. Avoidance behaviors, particularly in early-onset disorders such as SP and SAD, may be more strongly influenced by genetic factors. Large-scale genome-wide association studies (GWASs) grouping anxiety disorders have identified shared genetic loci, but GWASs for individual anxiety disorders are limited by small sample sizes. Grouping anxiety disorders into broader categories - namely, fear-dominant, mixed, and anxiety-dominant - rather than considering each specific anxiety disorder in isolation may lead to increased statistical power and yield more comprehensive perspectives on the shared and distinct clinical and genetic risk factors among anxiety disorders.

stories.hook: ¿Cómo el vínculo perinatal influye en la disociación?
stories.headline: El trauma perinatal altera el desarrollo y genera disociación
stories.finding: El modelo plantea que el trauma en la relación de apego perinatal interrumpe seis dominios de desarrollo (relacional, corporal, neurobiológico, emocional, cognitivo y moral). Estas interrupciones originan reacciones disociativas que se conciben como alteraciones evolutivas más que como meros síntomas.
stories.takeaway: Comprender el trauma perinatal como origen de la disociación permite diseñar intervenciones tempranas que reparen los procesos de apego y reduzcan la vulnerabilidad psicológica a lo largo de la vida.
stories.paperTitle: Trauma and Attachment in the Perinatal Period: A Developmental Model of Dissociation
stories.originalAbstract: Trauma and Attachment in the Perinatal Period offers a groundbreaking understanding of how early relationships—especially during the perinatal period—shape trauma and dissociation across the lifespan. Rather than focusing on events or diagnostic categories, this book explores how trauma within attachment relationships disrupts six areas of development: relational, bodily, neurobiological, emotional, cognitive, and moral. It introduces three original concepts: unseen attachment trauma (subtle yet deeply damaging relational ruptures), Thanatos attachment (a death-oriented attachment style), and dissociative reactions (developmental disruptions rather than mere symptoms). Grounded in hope, the book shows how transcendence is already present in the unborn child and can re-emerge through healing relationships. In this book, trauma therapists will find a flexible, process-oriented approach that maps each client’s unique trauma consequences and links them to tailored interventions, transforming complex developmental insights into practical therapeutic guidance.

stories.headline: Disponibilidad funcional predice la efectividad de la interpretación psicodinámica
stories.finding: Se analizaron dieciocho diarios del cliente, codificados por dos evaluadores en doce códigos durante cuatro fases. Los resultados indican que la disponibilidad de competencias desarrollativas básicas condiciona la simbolización del conflicto, estabilizándose antes que la accesibilidad.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que evaluar la disponibilidad funcional del paciente permite anticipar la respuesta a la interpretación, orientando la planificación terapéutica y mejorando la eficacia de la psicoterapia psicodinámica.
stories.paperTitle: When Interpretation Is Not Enough: Distinguishing Conflict and Deficit in OLI Integrative Psychodynamic Psychotherapy – Theoretical Considerations and a Longitudinal Single-Case Study with Content Analysis of Diary Entries
stories.journal: Insights Journal of the European Association for Integrative Psychodynamic Psychotherapy
stories.originalAbstract: In psychodynamic psychotherapy interpretation is the central mechanism of change, yet the same intervention helps some clients and not others. The paper proposes that the answer lies in distinguishing the diagnostic assessment of psychopathology from the assessment of functional availability: what the client has, at a given moment, to receive and work through an interpretation. Building on ego psychology, the paper shows how OLI Integrative Psychodynamic Psychotherapy operationalizes the distinction between intrapsychic conflict and developmental deficit through the concept of basic developmental competencies. The hypothesis is that this availability determines whether conflict is accessible to symbolization, and that its stabilization precedes that accessibility in time. The hypothesis was examined through a longitudinal single case study with two sources: the therapist's clinical formulation, and a directed content analysis of eighteen client diary entries, independently coded by two raters across twelve codes and four phases. Conflict and deficit coexisted in the same client; what changed over therapy was not the type of psychopathology but the hierarchical relationship between the two levels: conflict became accessible to symbolization only after the competencies had become functionally available. Developmental work through the therapeutic relationship, and through the transfer of functions, restored the availability of these competencies, and only with it did interpretive work become possible. The contribution lies in the procedure by which availability is tracked over time, and in the finding that the same client shows different blockages on different competencies, so the distinction between conflict and deficit must be posed per competency, not for the client as a whole.

stories.hook: ¿Cómo influye la regulación emocional en la agresión?
stories.headline: Uso de estrategias emocionales predice niveles de agresión: evidencia meta‑analítica
stories.finding: El meta‑análisis de 137 artículos (171 estudios, N = 252 605) mostró que las estrategias emocionales maladaptativas se relacionaron positivamente con la agresión (r = 0,329) y las dificultades de regulación también (r = 0,248), mientras que las estrategias adaptativas tuvieron una asociación negativa pequeña (r = ‑0,090).
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo subraya que intervenir sobre estrategias emocionales maladaptativas y mejorar la regulación puede reducir conductas agresivas, orientando tratamientos psicológicos y programas de prevención hacia habilidades de afrontamiento adaptativo.
stories.paperTitle: Emotion Regulation and Aggression: A Systematic Review and Meta‐Analysis
stories.originalAbstract: Research on emotion regulation (ER) and aggression has increased rapidly in the past years, but heterogeneity across studies make integration of findings challenging. To estimate the size and consistency of the relationship between ER and aggression we conducted a systematic review and meta‐analysis. In total, 16,369 articles were retrieved from Scopus, PubMed, PsycINFO, and CINAHL, and 137 articles (171 studies) provided 918 effect sizes from a total sample of N = 252,605. Multilevel models showed significant pooled relationships, with small‐to‐moderate effects. Use of adaptive strategies was associated with lower aggression ( r = −0.090, I 2 = 78%), but the precision estimate test (PET) bias corrected effect was non‐significant. Use of maladaptive strategies ( r = 0.329, I 2 = 93%), and difficulties regulating emotions ( r = 0.248, I 2 = 89%), were associated with higher aggression. P‐ curves suggested little evidence of selective reporting while cumulative meta‐analysis showed relatively consistent effects over time. Moderator analyses showed that effects were generally stronger for physical and other forms of aggression than sexual aggression, and weaker for intimate partner targets than other targets. Difficulties in ER were most strongly related to reactive compared with proactive aggression, but the use of ER strategies did not differ between motivations. Our findings suggest that interventions targeting ER, including those that explore and challenge angry predispositions and provide skills to manage impulse control, may help to prevent aggressive behaviour.

stories.hook: ¿Puede la IA mejorar la terapia cognitivo-conductual para el insomnio?
stories.headline: La terapia cognitivo-conductual digital con IA mejora significativamente los parámetros de sueño
stories.finding: Una revisión sistemática que incluyó 78 estudios (2004‑2024) y siguió las directrices PRISMA encontró que la terapia cognitivo-conductual digital potenciada con IA produce mejoras significativas en los parámetros de sueño. Además, se observó un aumento de la adherencia de los pacientes al tratamiento.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo respalda la incorporación de plataformas digitales con IA en la práctica clínica, ofreciendo una alternativa escalable y personalizada que puede ampliar el acceso a la CBT‑I y mejorar los resultados del sueño en pacientes con insomnio.
stories.paperTitle: Digital and AI-Enhanced Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Insomnia: Neurocognitive Mechanisms and Clinical Outcomes
stories.originalAbstract: Background/Objectives: This systematic review explores the integration of digital and AI-enhanced cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) for insomnia, focusing on underlying neurocognitive mechanisms and associated clinical outcomes. Insomnia significantly impairs cognitive functioning, overall health, and quality of life. Although traditional CBT has demonstrated efficacy, its scalability and ability to deliver individualized care remain limited. Emerging AI-driven interventions—including chatbots, mobile applications, and web-based platforms—present innovative avenues for delivering more accessible and personalized insomnia treatments. Methods: Following PRISMA guidelines, this review synthesized findings from 78 studies published between 2004 and 2024. A systematic search was conducted across PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, and PsycINFO. Studies were included based on predefined criteria prioritizing randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and high-quality empirical research that evaluated AI-augmented CBT interventions targeting sleep disorders, particularly insomnia. Results: The findings suggest that digital and AI-enhanced CBT significantly improves sleep parameters, patient adherence, satisfaction, and the personalization of therapy in alignment with individual neurocognitive profiles. Moreover, these technologies address critical limitations of conventional CBT, notably those related to access and scalability. AI-based tools appear especially promising in optimizing treatment delivery and adapting interventions to cognitive-behavioral patterns. Conclusions: While AI-enhanced CBT demonstrates strong potential for advancing insomnia treatment through neurocognitive personalization and broader clinical accessibility, several challenges persist. These include uncertainties surrounding long-term efficacy, practical implementation barriers, and ethical considerations. Future large-scale longitudinal research is necessary to confirm the sustained neurocognitive and behavioral benefits of digital and AI-powered CBT for insomnia.

stories.hook: ¿Qué tan efectivas son las apps de mindfulness en cáncer?
stories.headline: Intervenciones digitales mejoran salud psicológica en pacientes oncológicos
stories.finding: El análisis incluyó 191 estudios con 29.907 pacientes y cuidadores, revelando que las intervenciones digitales mostraron efectos positivos en la salud psicológica y cognitiva. Sin embargo, los dominios de adopción y mantenimiento fueron los menos informados.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo orienta a clínicos y diseñadores a priorizar la implementación sostenible de apps de mindfulness, asegurando que no solo sean efectivas sino también adoptables y mantenibles en la práctica oncológica.
stories.paperTitle: Digital health interventions for psychological and cognitive care in cancer patients and caregivers: A RE‐AIM‐based systematic review
stories.originalAbstract: Beyond physical challenges, cancer can cause psychological and cognitive challenges for patients, caregivers, and family members. Digital health interventions show promise in addressing these issues. However, evidence on their applicability in daily cancer care is limited. The objective of this systematic review is to evaluate the internal and external validity of digital health interventions targeting psychological and cognitive impairments in cancer patients, caregivers, and family members, using the RE-AIM framework. This systematic review was conducted following the PRISMA guidelines, using Pubmed/MEDLINE, Scopus, and PsychINFO databases. Data were extracted using data forms based on the RE-AIM framework. The methodological quality was assessed using the Quality Assessment Tool for Quantitative Studies (QATQS). A total of 191 studies involving 29.907 patients and caregivers met the inclusion criteria. Included studies were randomized controlled trials and nonrandomized studies of interventions related to digital health, using an online or hybrid format. The reach, implementation, and effectiveness domains were most frequently reported, while adoption and maintenance were the most unreported domains within the RE-AIM framework. Despite reporting on reach, effectiveness, and implementation, limited data on external validity restricts the impact and scalability of digital health interventions in cancer care. Future research should endeavor to address current challenges and improve the use of digital health interventions in cancer care.

stories.hook: ¿Por qué el impostor reduce la confianza?
stories.headline: El fenómeno del impostor se vincula a perfeccionismo y baja autoeficacia
stories.finding: En una muestra de 505 estudiantes universitarios saudíes, el fenómeno del impostor mostró una asociación positiva moderada con el perfeccionismo maladaptativo (r = 0.56, p < 0.01). Asimismo, se observó una asociación negativa débil con la autoeficacia (r = -0.19, p < 0.01) y con la felicidad.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que el sentimiento de impostor puede erosionar la autoestima y el bienestar, indicando la necesidad de intervenciones que fortalezcan la autoeficacia y reduzcan el perfeccionismo maladaptativo en contextos académicos.
stories.paperTitle: Impostor phenomenon among Saudi university students: associations with maladaptive perfectionism, self-efficacy, and psychological well-being
stories.originalAbstract: Background: The impostor phenomenon (IP) is characterized by persistent self-doubt and fears of being exposed as intellectually inadequate despite evidence of competence. Although IP has received increasing international attention, comparatively few studies have simultaneously examined its associations with maladaptive perfectionism, self-efficacy, belonging, and wellbeing within Middle Eastern university contexts. This study examined the associations among IP, maladaptive perfectionism, self-efficacy, happiness, sense of belonging, and perceived academic competition among university students in Saudi Arabia. Methods: A cross-sectional study was conducted among 505 undergraduate students at Taibah University, Saudi Arabia. Participants completed validated measures assessing IP, self-efficacy, maladaptive perfectionism, happiness, belonging, and perceived academic competition. Inferential statistics and bootstrapped indirect association analyses using Hayes' PROCESS Model 4 were conducted. Results: IP demonstrated a moderate positive association with maladaptive perfectionism (r = 0.56, p < 0.01) and weak negative associations with self-efficacy (r = -0.19, p < 0.01) and happiness (r = -0.20, p < 0.01). Self-efficacy showed moderate positive associations with happiness (r = 0.53, p < 0.01) and sense of belonging (r = 0.40, p < 0.01). Indirect association analyses identified statistically significant patterns of association among maladaptive perfectionism, IP, and self-efficacy. Students from administrative and humanities colleges reported higher IP scores than students from health and scientific colleges. Conclusion: IP among Saudi university students was associated with greater maladaptive perfectionism and lower self-efficacy, whereas self-efficacy demonstrated stronger positive associations with happiness and belonging. The findings highlight the importance of cognitive and emotional factors associated with students' psychological experiences in higher education settings. Given the cross-sectional design, all findings should be interpreted cautiously, and longitudinal studies are needed to better understand these relationships over time.

stories.hook: ¿Qué estrategias individuales reducen el burnout de enfermeras?
stories.headline: Estrategias individuales reducen burnout de enfermeras según revisión de evidencia
stories.finding: La revisión integró once revisiones sistemáticas publicadas entre 2012 y 2021 y clasificó las estrategias individuales en tres dominios: salud mental (51 %), actividades físicas (26 %) y competencia profesional (13 %). Las intervenciones más frecuentemente reportadas fueron basadas en mindfulness.
stories.takeaway: Este panorama cuantitativo orienta a gestores y profesionales de enfermería a priorizar intervenciones de salud mental, especialmente programas de mindfulness, como la vía más respaldada para mitigar el burnout individual en entornos hospitalarios.
stories.paperTitle: Effectiveness of Individual-Based Strategies to Reduce Nurse Burnout: An Umbrella Review
stories.originalAbstract: Aims: This umbrella review aims to comprehensively synthesize and analyze the findings of available systematic reviews on the effectiveness of individual-based strategies for reducing nurse burnout occurring in hospital-based settings. Methods: Following JBI guidelines, an umbrella review was conducted to integrate the effectiveness of various strategies to reduce burnout. Systematic reviews were searched in the Embase, MEDLINE (Ovid), Cochrane Library, CINAHL (EBSCO), Scopus, and WOS databases. Inclusion criteria included studies published in any language from database inception to April 2023. Eligibility assessment involved two independent reviewers who evaluated titles, abstracts, and full texts. The systematic reviews were critically evaluated using JBI SUMARI. The results were narratively synthesized and grouped by strategy. Results: Eleven systematic reviews were included, covering the years 2012 to 2021. The appraisal tools varied, though all included reviews were of high quality. The strategies were categorized into three domains: mental health (51%), physical activities (26%), and professional competence (13%). The interventions most identified were mindfulness-based stress reduction for mental health, yoga for physical activities, and professional competence education. These individual-based strategies were shown to effectively eliminate emotional exhaustion (72.7%), depersonalization (44%), and occupational stress (78%) among nurses in hospital-based settings. Conclusion: Mental health, physical activities, and professional competence are strategies to reduce nurse burnout. Implementing these approaches in healthcare settings can improve emotional exhaustion, depersonalization, and occupational stress of nurses.

stories.hook: ¿Qué factores realmente predicen el divorcio a largo plazo?
stories.headline: Predictores individuales, interpersonales y socioeconómicos explican el 39% de divorcios en 12 años
stories.finding: El estudio siguió a 368 parejas heterosexuales recién casadas durante 12 años, de las cuales el 39 % se divorció. Los modelos bayesianos de ecuaciones estructurales y análisis de supervivencia mostraron que vulnerabilidades individuales, riesgos socioeconómicos y conductas adaptativas aportan explicaciones únicas al riesgo de divorcio, superando los modelos centrados solo en la comunicación de pareja.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que la prevención del divorcio debe abordar no solo la comunicación de pareja, sino también vulnerabilidades personales y contextos socioeconómicos, orientando intervenciones hacia factores estructurales y de resiliencia temprana.
stories.paperTitle: Individual, interpersonal, and socioeconomic predictors of divorce: A 12-year prospective study.
stories.journal: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology
stories.originalAbstract: Divorce is among the most common and costly life disruptions adults may face. Maladaptive and ineffective couple communication is routinely implicated in leading models as the cause of divorce, and interventions designed to prevent divorce accordingly prioritize changes in couple interaction patterns. Yet research linking couple communication to divorce has been inconsistent, and failures of communication-based interventions highlight the need for an expanded view of early signs of risk. Alternative perspectives on divorce draw attention to the vulnerabilities individuals bring into marriage and the socioeconomic circumstances couples must navigate once married, yet the predictive power of these perspectives has never been directly compared to the behavioral model. The current analyses address this gap through a study of 368 different-sex newlywed couples who provided data on six clusters of predictors within 6 months of marriage: relationship satisfaction for each spouse, individual vulnerabilities for each spouse, couples' adaptive behavior, and socioeconomic risk. Over the next 12 years, 39% of couples divorced. Preregistered Bayesian structural equation models and survival analyses demonstrated that each baseline risk factor independently predicted divorce in the expected direction. When all predictors were included simultaneously, only wives' individual vulnerabilities predicted divorce. Adaptive communication behaviors attenuated the risk conferred by wives' vulnerabilities. The best performing model explained 34% of variance in divorce, suggesting that at least one third of couples' divorce risk is detectable early in marriage. Exploring vulnerabilities and their effects promises to deepen understanding of how relationships develop and deteriorate and can clarify boundary conditions of behavioral models of divorce. (PsycInfo Database Record (c) 2026 APA, all rights reserved).

stories.hook: ¿Puede una IA generar mayor cercanía que un humano?
stories.headline: IA supera a humanos en crear cercanía interpersonal cuando se cree humana
stories.finding: En dos ensayos controlados aleatorizados con 492 participantes, la IA etiquetada como humana generó mayores sentimientos de cercanía que los interlocutores humanos, gracias a su mayor autodescubrimiento; al etiquetarse como IA, la cercanía disminuyó pero persistió.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que la percepción de humanidad potencia la conexión emocional, lo que implica que los diseñadores de IA deben considerar la presentación del agente para fomentar relaciones sociales efectivas.
stories.paperTitle: AI outperforms humans in establishing interpersonal closeness in emotionally engaging interactions, but only when labelled as human
stories.originalAbstract: With the increasing accessibility of large language models to the public, questions arise about whether, and under what conditions, social-emotional interactions with artificial intelligence (AI) can lead to human-like relationship building. Across two double-blind randomised controlled studies with pre-registered analyses, 492 participants engaged in dyadic online interactions using a modified, text-based version of the 'Fast Friends Procedure' (a method designed to enable rapid relationship building), with pre-generated responses by either human partners or a minimally prompted large language model. When labelled as human, the AI outperformed human partners in establishing feelings of closeness during emotionally engaging 'deep-talk' interactions. This striking effect appears to stem from the AI's higher levels of self-disclosure, which in turn enhanced participants' perceptions of closeness. Labelling the partner as an AI reduced, but did not eliminate, relationship building, likely due to participants' lower motivation to engage in interactions with an AI, reflected in both shorter responses and reduced feelings of closeness. These findings highlight AI's potential to relieve overburdened social fields while underscoring the urgent need for ethical safeguards to prevent its misuse in fostering deceptive social connections.

stories.hook: ¿Por qué la vergüenza financiera afecta la salud mental?
stories.headline: Factores que amplifican y amortiguan la vergüenza financiera en Nueva Zelanda
stories.finding: En una muestra de 704 adultos neozelandeses, se identificaron variables que modulan la vergüenza financiera. Responsabilidad económica del hogar y comparaciones sociales la aumentan, mientras que la alfabetización financiera y la autoeficacia la disminuyen.
stories.takeaway: Comprender estos impulsores permite diseñar intervenciones educativas y de apoyo que reduzcan la vergüenza financiera, mejorando la salud mental y evitando consecuencias como depresión o aislamiento.
stories.originalAbstract: Households are increasingly indebted, with the financial pressure being associated with stress and depression, worsening physical and mental health, suicide, and divorce. Compounding this is a taboo regarding talking about money, with many individuals concealing their financial problems, avoiding addressing their financial difficulties, and withdrawing and isolating themselves. With all the spiralling negative effects of financial stress and debt on an individual’s well-being, it is critical that we understand financial shame. This research aims to explore the factors that amplify and buffer financial shame. Across Aotearoa New Zealand, 704 Kiwis were asked to answer questions on psychosocial processes, lifetime factors, contextual conditions, and personal resources, identified through prior research on general shame. These factors included role-based identity proxied with household financial responsibilities, group membership based on ethnic and religious affiliations, financial literacy and self-efficacy, and the importance of social comparisons. This research probed the individual’s past financial journey, including childhood socio-economic upbringing and family financial socialization, financial hardship and material deprivation in later life, and explored their current financial circumstances. The univariate analyses showed that most of the investigated factors significantly influenced financial shame. Lack of control over household finances, low self-efficacy, collectivist orientations, and weak ethnic belonging were associated with higher shame, whilst financial literacy and confidence acted as strong buffers. Social comparison emerged as a central amplifier, with financial hardship – both in childhood and adulthood – as a consistent predictor. Subjective financial well-being protected more strongly against shame than objective measures, highlighting the psychological nature of financial distress. Regression results confirmed that self-efficacy (negatively) and social comparison (positively) had the strongest correlations with financial shame, while current financial circumstances is likely a critical trigger towards feeling financial shame, with past hardship likely serving as a key source of shame-proneness. Cluster analysis further reinforced these dynamics, revealing six distinct financial shame personas that differed based on respondents’ agency regarding financial decisions, confidence, cultural orientation, social comparisons, and financial stability. The shame components were also used to establish unique groupings that can be used to understand how background, beliefs and resources shape the emotional experiences of money. Across all models, age consistently moderated the experience of shame – both buffering and amplifying its effects, depending on life stage – demonstrating that financial shame is multi-dimensional, context-dependent, and deeply rooted in both one’s financial trajectory and sense of identity. The research findings reinforce that financial shame is not simply about money, but reflects a deeper judgement of the self, with the meaning people attach to money, such as competence, responsibility, independence, and success, as the core driver. This research presents some opportunities to build financial shame resilience, and contributes to what is currently a very limited literature on a critical issue. Opening up these discussions on financial shame enables developing effective interventions that remove these money and debt taboos, and help those who need help the most, with urgency and purpose.

stories.hook: ¿Por qué el apoyo informal a padres en duelo puede dañar?
stories.headline: El apoyo informal a padres en duelo a menudo intensifica el sufrimiento
stories.finding: En un estudio cualitativo con dieciséis padres en duelo en Australia, se realizaron entrevistas semiestructuradas y análisis temático reflexivo. Los resultados mostraron que las interacciones de apoyo informal rara vez son neutrales: pueden proporcionar una sensación de seguridad o, por el contrario, aumentar el malestar mediante juicios o evitación.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo alerta a profesionales y redes de apoyo sobre la necesidad de entrenar a los acompañantes para ofrecer un soporte empático y no juzgador, favoreciendo la resiliencia del doliente.
stories.paperTitle: Reciprocal regulation in social support interactions between bereaved parents and their potential supporters: a qualitative study
stories.originalAbstract: Introduction The death of a child represents one of life’s most profound stressors, often resulting in long-term emotional dysregulation and the potential for mental health diagnoses. This qualitative study explores how bereaved parents experience informal social support attempts. Methods Sixteen bereaved parents in Australia were recruited through social media and bereavement support networks and participated in in-depth, semi-structured interviews. Reflexive thematic analysis was applied to interpret participant narratives, with data collection and analysis conducted iteratively. Findings revealed that potential support interactions were rarely neutral: they either offered grounding through perceived safety, or heightened distress through judgement or avoidance. Results Four overarching themes were developed: Societal Norms (The Western World), articulating societal bereavement norms; Bereaved Parents’ Experiences (The Untethered World) , describing bereaved parents’ internal disruption of identity and coherence; Potential Support Providers’ Perceived Experience (The Uncertain World) , capturing perceptions of informal social support providers’ uncertainty with providing support; and Quality of Interactions (The Precarious World) , detailing how support interactions either alleviated or exacerbated bereaved parents’ distress. A key mechanism, reciprocal regulation, was identified, whereby bereaved parents mirrored the emotional availability or avoidance of their potential support providers. The findings articulate the complexities of social support done well by affirming the importance of attunement. Discussion This study offers an expanded understanding of grief as a relationally co-regulated process and calls for improved grief literacy and societal support.

stories.hook: ¿Pueden los ojos revelar la atención en TDAH?
stories.headline: Duraciones de sacádas más largas distinguen TDAH en tareas de realidad virtual
stories.finding: En 34 pacientes con TDAH y 30 controles, las sacádas fueron más largas en el TDAH durante la tarea tradicional de realidad virtual. Después de controlar edad y sexo, la duración de sacádas siguió siendo significativa y, junto a errores de omisión, ofreció una precisión discreta para distinguir los grupos.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que medidas oculomotoras en entornos inmersivos pueden servir como biomarcadores objetivos para identificar subtipos de TDAH y guiar intervenciones personalizadas.
stories.paperTitle: Virtual Reality Attention Tasks in Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder: II. Eye Movement Patterns and Multimodal Behavioural Integration
stories.originalAbstract: Attention deficit hyperactivity disorder is associated with differences in behavioural regulation and oculomotor control.Previous studies have investigated eye-tracking measures to assess differences between people with attention deficit hyperactivity disorder and neurotypical participants, but inconsistent results have been reported across tasks.This condition is increasingly being characterised as heterogeneous in nature, raising the possibility that multimodal approaches may better characterise it.Sixty-four participants (34 people with attention deficit hyperactivity disorder and 30 neurotypical participants) were included.Participants completed ten virtual reality tasks in real-life contexts while background and behavioural performance (evaluated in Part I) and eye movement patterns (current study) were analysed.Oculomotor differences varied by task and the clearest difference was observed during the traditionally formatted task (Task 2) with longer saccade durations.After accounting for age and gender, saccade duration remained significant and had a modest discriminatory accuracy between groups.Combining oculomotor (saccade duration) with behavioural measure (omission error rate) in Task 2, improved classification performance.Likelihood ratio tests indicated that omission error rate significantly improved the saccade-duration-only model.Results suggest that combining behavioural and oculomotor measures can provide complementary classification information.Additionally, utilising ecologically valid tasks in virtual reality and multimodal integration may enhance objective assessment strategies for this condition.

stories.hook: ¿Por qué la regulación emocional predice trastornos alimentarios?
stories.headline: Dificultades en la regulación emocional se asocian moderadamente con trastornos alimentarios en jóvenes
stories.finding: Un meta‑análisis de 23 estudios (2010‑2024) halló una correlación media entre dificultades de regulación emocional y trastornos alimentarios (r = 0,418). Los subgrupos mostraron correlaciones similares (r = 0,428) y ni el IMC ni el género alteraron significativamente la asociación.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo subraya que intervenir en la regulación emocional puede ser una vía eficaz para prevenir o tratar los trastornos alimentarios en adolescentes y adultos jóvenes, orientando programas de prevención y terapias centradas en habilidades emocionales.
stories.paperTitle: Emotion regulation difficulties and disordered eating in adolescents and young adults: a meta-analysis
stories.originalAbstract: Eating disorders and difficulties in regulating emotions are frequent among adolescents and serve as risk factors for several health issues. Nonetheless, the relationship remains ambiguous; investigating this connection will not only elucidate the associations between the two illnesses. Nevertheless, it will offer theoretical backing for interventions targeting the pertinent illnesses. This study seeks to examine the relationship between emotion management and disordered eating while assessing the moderating influences of Body Mass Index (BMI) and gender to enhance future interventions for eating disorders. We conducted a search in April 2024 and updated it in November of the same year, encompassing literature published from 2010 to November 2024 across five English and Chinese databases. A random effects model was conducted to analyze research outcomes. This meta-analysis encompassed 23 research, demonstrating a medium positive connection between difficulties in regulating emotions and disordered eating (r = 0.418). Subgroup analyses revealed medium positive relationships between difficulties in emotion regulation and disordered eating (r = 0.428), loss-of-control eating disorders (r = 0.410), and emotional eating (r = 0.370). The meta-regression analysis revealed that gender significantly moderates this association, but BMI does not. The present study indicated that adolescents or young adults with difficulties in emotional regulation are susceptible to displaying symptoms of eating disorders in both sexes; however, in females, emotional regulation issues are more likely to be associated with eating disorders. Future longitudinal or experimental researches are needed to reveal the causal relationship between the two variables and the similarities and variations between genders during adolescence and early adulthood.

stories.hook: ¿Pueden los psicodélicos remodelar el cerebro en una sola dosis?
stories.headline: Los psicodélicos inducen plasticidad sináptica mediante permeabilidad intracelular
stories.finding: En neuronas cultivadas, los psicodélicos serotonérgicos y sus análogos no alucinógenos aumentan el crecimiento dendrítico y la sinaptogénesis cuando son permeables a la célula. En circuitos corticales, la estimulación del receptor 5‑HT2A potencia la señalización glutamatérgica AMPA y activa programas génicos asociados a la plasticidad, favoreciendo el aprendizaje de extinción.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que la capacidad de los psicodélicos para penetrar intracelularmente es clave para desencadenar cambios estructurales duraderos, ofreciendo una base biológica para sus efectos antidepresivos rápidos y abriendo nuevas vías terapéuticas basadas en la plasticidad sináptica.
stories.paperTitle: Mechanisms of neuroplasticity induced by permeable serotonergics
stories.originalAbstract: Major depression affects about 280 million people worldwide and costs around 326 billion dollars per year in the United States, though the standard medications take 2-3 months to take effect, so faster and longer-lasting treatments are needed. Serotonergic psychedelics such as psilocybin, DMT or ayahuasca, LSD, and mescaline can reduce depression and anxiety symptoms after only one or two doses, with benefits that last from weeks to months. The persistence of psychedelic benefits points to real biological change, not just temporary drug action. Variants in the serotonin HTR2A gene can influence cortical serotonin 5-HT2A receptor density and may shape sensitivity. In cultured neurons, multiple psychedelic chemotypes and non-hallucinogenic analogs increase dendritic growth and synaptogenesis, while impermeable analogs fail unless forced into the cell, showing that intracellular permeability is required. In cortical circuits, 5-HT2A stimulation increases glutamatergic drive and AMPA signaling, triggers gene programs linked to plasticity, and supports extinction learning. Across species, these changes align with antidepressant and anxiolytic-like behaviors that can last days to weeks and may not require hallucinogenic effects. Here, I discuss genetics, cellular and systems research, animal behavior, and recent human data to explain how membrane-permeable serotonergics act as neuroplastogens, which help build out neural synapses. I propose a permeability plus mechanism model; The serotonergic mechanism must be both cell-permeable and engage 5-HT2A. A permeable psychedelic reaches intracellular 5-HT2A pools, then 5-HT2A activation quickly boosts plasticity related gene expression and causes structural change, 5-HT2A signaling raises BDNF and engages TrkB to support neuronal growth, and 5-HT2A activation in cortex increases glutamate and AMPA signaling that helps stabilize new synapses, together linking permeability, receptor engagement, and circuit activity to durable neuroplasticity.
